title: Losing money doesn't make it a hobby
caption: Most people think a business that loses money is just a hobby. The Supreme Court said losses are a clue, not the verdict. Here's the test the CRA uses. #sidehustle #canada #smallbusiness

title: The side hustle bill nobody plans for
caption: If you work for yourself, you're the employer too, so you pay both halves of CPP. Here's what that means in 2026. Not tax advice. #sidehustle #canada #cpp

title: Your home insurance probably skips this
caption: Running a side hustle from home? The Insurance Bureau of Canada says to tell your insurer, and home policies usually cover very little business equipment or liability. #sidehustle #canada #smallbusiness
